<!--
  The simple steps (model steps@1): the heading, a description and the steps as an ordered list, each with its
  short label (a badge), a title and a line. Axes: layout (row: the steps in columns, column: one under the
  other with the label at the side), cols (3, 4 columns of the row).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { SimpleStep } from "./steps-simple.types";

  export type StepsSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    steps: SimpleStep[];
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    layout?: "row" | "column";
    cols?: "3" | "4";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    description = "",
    steps,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "center",
    layout = "row",
    cols = "4",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: StepsSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
  const grid = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "column" ? ""
    : (cols as string) === "3" ? "sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3"
    : "sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4"
  );
  const narrow = $derived(((layout as string) === "column") ? "mx-auto max-w-2xl" : "");
  const item = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "column" ? "flex flex-row items-start gap-6"
    : (align as string) === "center" ? "flex flex-col items-center gap-4"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "flex flex-col items-end gap-4"
    : "flex flex-col items-start gap-4"
  );
  const copyAlign = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "column" ? "start"
    : (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const copyText = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "column" ? "text-start"
    : (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="steps-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack gap="12" align="stretch" class={narrow}>
      <Stack gap="4" align={column} class={cn("max-w-2xl", selfAlign)}>
        <Title as={level} size="3xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="base" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <List tag="ol" class={cn("m-0 grid w-full list-none grid-cols-1 gap-8 p-0", grid)}>
        {#each steps as s (s.id)}
          <ListItem class={item} data-slot="step">
            <Badge variant="secondary">
              {s.label}
            </Badge>
            <Stack gap="2" align={copyAlign}>
              <Title as={(level + 1)} size="lg" weight="semibold" class={copyText}>
                {s.title}
              </Title>
              {#if s.description}
                <Text size="sm" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", copyText)}>
                  {s.description}
                </Text>
              {/if}
            </Stack>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </Stack>
  </Container>
</Block>
